title: fix(app-shell,console): an approver who opens an approval request sees its decision panel again, read from the approvals service
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb22AjUGXrSeDsZKcAbfc4AY)_
Fixes #28546

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

domain:ui#4 card thread · os-dev · session_01QsR2jUw276TncPo635XS3B · claim 6554793732

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 审批请求（`sys_approval_request`）自己的记录页不再走通用数据接口的一次性页面载荷（`POST /api/v1/data/:object/:id/page`），而是像 #27713 之前那样各部分分别读取；控制台把请求本身路由到 `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/:id`。控制台的两个审批数据源还会直接拒绝请求对象的 `getRecordPage`，预取则什么都不发。
- **为什么改：** 非管理员审批人在数据接口上没有该对象的读权限，页面载荷答 403，从审批收件箱、`?request=` 链接或直接打开记录页都只看到“无权访问”，没有同意/拒绝；管理员审批人拿到的是数据库原样行，没有 `viewer`，所以决策按钮不出现，`pending_approvers` 是逗号拼接的字符串，“等待”一栏按字符一个一个画芯片。这是 18.3.0 的发版阻塞项。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响审批请求这一个对象的记录页：多了几个分开的请求（与 #27713 之前相同），其它对象的记录页仍是一个请求。数据接口的权限没有放宽。回滚 = revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`（`recordPagePlan` 里对请求对象提前返回空计划，以及抽屉里相关计数预热的条件）；`ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts`（`guardRecordPageRead`）；`ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.recordPagePayload-28546.test.tsx`（真实 `ObjectStackAdapter` 下的验收用例）。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.recordPagePayload-28546.test.tsx` → 10 个用例全绿：非管理员从收件箱点开、冷加载记录页、`?request=` 深链都看到决策面板，同意一次后按钮消失；管理员审批人看到同意/拒绝和每人一个芯片；整个过程没有任何发往 `/api/v1/data/sys_approval_request` 的请求。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The defect, measured.** Since #27713 the record page takes its record from `DataSource.getRecordPage`, the data API's `POST /data/:object/:id/page`. `routeApprovalRecordReads` overrides only `find` and `findOne`, so on a request's own page that read reached the console's adapter unchanged:

- a **non-admin approver** is refused `sys_approval_request` on the data API, so the payload answered 403 and the page drew `record-access-denied` ("You don't have access to Approval Request records"), on the inbox row, on a cold load of the record route and on the `?request=` deep link;
- an **admin approver** was answered the stored row: no `viewer` block, so the decision actions' `record.viewer.can_act` predicates failed closed (no Approve, no Reject), and `pending_approvers` as the comma-joined string, so the "Waiting on" strip drew one chip per character.

Both are reproduced by the new console test on the base sources (below), over the real `ObjectStackAdapter`.

**The fix routes the read, not the grant** (triage 6554139580). Nothing about what the data API lets an approver read changes.

- `RecordDetailView`: `recordPagePlan` is empty for `sys_approval_request`, so a request's page asks no payload. Every part reads on its own through the adapter, as before #27713: the record through `findOne`, which the console routes to `GET /approvals/requests/:id` (with `viewer`, the decision tally and the approvers as an array); the timeline through the actions route; the header verdicts and the field projection through their own reads. The now-constant `approvals` flag of the plan reads `true`.
- `RecordDetailView`, drawer: the related-count warm-up for the next record was skipped whenever the adapter has `prefetchRecordPage`. It is now skipped only when the open actually asks a payload, so a request opened in a drawer keeps warming its neighbour's counts (otherwise this change would leave it with neither).
- `approvalRequestsDataSource.ts`: both routed sources (`routeApprovalRecordReads` and the inbox's scoped `createApprovalRequestsDataSource`) refuse a request's `getRecordPage` with the existing `UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM` refusal before any request goes out, and send nothing for a request's `prefetchRecordPage`. Every other object's call is the host's, and over a host without the payload neither member appears. This guard is not reachable from today's UI (the page asks no payload for a request); it keeps a future caller from drawing a request from the data API's row through this door, which is how this card and #25228 both happened.

**File surface:** exactly the claim's (`ui/apps/console/src/services/**`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`) plus one new app-shell test file beside it and the changeset. No producer change elsewhere was needed: the approvals get already serves the request correctly.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.recordPagePayload-28546.test.tsx` (10 cases), the console's composition over the **real** `ObjectStackAdapter` under `ApprovalRecordReads`, the real inbox page on the account app's `component/approvals/inbox` route and the real `RecordDetailView` with the served request page. Only `fetch` (answered as the server does, per persona) and the inbox's queue read are doubled.
  - `approvals.account-app-entry` acceptance[3]: a row click opens `/apps/com.objectstack.account/sys_approval_request/record/ID`, the decision panel draws Approve and Reject, one approval POSTs through the action door, the request is re-read from the approvals get and the decisions stop rendering.
  - acceptance[3], cold load of the record route.
  - acceptance[4]: `?request=ID` on the component route replaces itself with the record route, which shows that request; Back leaves to the previous entry.
  - an admin pending approver, whom the data API's page route answers 200: Approve and Reject draw, and the strip has one chip per approver (`Dev Admin`, `Ada Auditor`, `Lee Legal`).
  - every case asserts the page sent **no** request to `/api/v1/data/sys_approval_request` at all, and no `record-access-denied`.
  - both routed sources: a request's `getRecordPage` rejects with `UNSUPPORTED_QUERY_PARAM` and never reaches the host; a request's prefetch is dropped; another object's calls are the host's; CONTROL: over a host without the payload, neither member exists.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalRequestPage-28546.test.tsx` (3 cases, real adapter): a request's page reads its record by `findOne` and sends no page request; CONTROL: an ordinary record on the same adapter opens with its page request; in a drawer, a request's next neighbour has its related counts warmed and no page is asked.

<details><summary>Readings (head 6d6aea80 unless named)</summary>

- New files on the fix, `6d6aea80`: `pnpm exec vitest run` of both new files plus `RecordDetailView.recordPagePayload-27627.test.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.recordReadFailure-11902.test.tsx` (the two existing payload pins): **4 files, 28 tests passed**.
- **Red on the old code** (reverse verification, `d8234f05` with `RecordDetailView.tsx` and `approvalRequestsDataSource.ts` restored to the base `617dcf43`, blob hashes checked on disk, restored from `HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty): **10 failed, 3 passed** (the 3 are the CONTROL cases). The member cases drew `record-access-denied` ("You don't have access to Approval Request records"); the admin case drew the panel with no `declared-action-approval_approve` and five `approver-chip`s for the slate `u1,u2,u3`, the issue's per-character chips.
- Ablation, drawer warm-up gate alone (`recordPagePlan &&` removed through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, restored blob equal to `HEAD`): exactly the drawer case red (1 failed, 2 passed).
- Ablation, `routeApprovalRecordReads`' guard alone: exactly its two pins red (2 failed, 8 passed); the integration cases stay green because the page asks no payload for a request. The guard is declared above as unreachable from today's UI.
- Neighbouring suites, every `ui/packages/app-shell` and `ui/apps/console` test file that names `RecordDetailView`, `recordPagePayload`, `approvalRequestsDataSource`, `routeApprovalRecordReads` or `ApprovalRecordReads` (`git grep -l`, 227 files) at `010fbf63`, two locked batches at `--maxWorkers=2`: **114 files / 903 tests passed** and **113 files / 817 tests passed**. A narrowing: CI's Test UI runs the rest. The merge of main at `6d6aea80` touched no file under `ui/`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: both `Done`, exit 0 (`010fbf63`).

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The live retest on the P0 item (`approvals.account-app-entry`, a booted showcase with the invited member) is QA's, per the triage. NOT MEASURED here: no browser run against a booted showcase; the jsdom harness runs the shipped adapter, routed source, inbox page and record view, with only the HTTP transport doubled.
- #28470 (open, unclaimed) proposes adding more parts to the same record page payload. With this PR a request's page asks none of it, so that proposal does not reach approval requests.
